name: @activepieces/piece-fireflies-ai
description: Meeting assistant that automatically records, transcribes, and analyzes conversations

auth.description:
To use Fireflies.ai, you need to get an API key:
1. Login to your account at https://fireflies.ai.
2. Navigate to Settings > Developer Settings in the left sidebar.
3. Copy the API key from the API Key section.

find-meeting-by-id.name: find-meeting-by-id
find-meeting-by-id.description: Finds a specific meeting by ID.

meetingId.description: The ID of the meeting to retrieve.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches a single Fireflies meeting transcript (with summary, speakers, attendees, and media URLs) by its exact transcript/meeting ID. Use when you already have a known meeting ID and want its full details; if you only have search criteria like title or date, use the search action instead. Read-only and idempotent.

find_recent_meeting.name: find_recent_meeting
find_recent_meeting.description: Retrieves the latest meeting for a user.

aiMetadata.description: Returns the most recently transcribed Fireflies meeting for the authenticated account, including its full transcript and summary. Use when the agent wants the latest meeting without knowing its ID; takes no inputs. Returns a found:false result when the account has no recent meeting. Read-only and idempotent.

find_meeting_by_query.name: find_meeting_by_query
find_meeting_by_query.description: Searches meetings based on provided parameters.

aiMetadata.description: Searches Fireflies meeting transcripts, optionally filtered by title, host email, participant email, and/or date, paging through all matches. Use when locating meetings by attributes rather than a known ID; leaving all filters empty returns the full meeting history. Read-only and idempotent.

upload_audio.name: upload_audio
upload_audio.description: Creates a new meeeting in Fireflies for transcription (requires a publicly accessible URL).

audioUrl.description: The publicly accessible URL to your audio file (mp3, mp4, wav, m4a, ogg). Fireflies API only accepts URLs, not direct file uploads. For private files, consider using signed URLs with short expiry times.

aiMetadata.description: Submits a publicly accessible audio/video URL (mp3, mp4, wav, m4a, ogg) to Fireflies to create a new meeting and transcribe it. Use when the agent has a recording it wants transcribed and analyzed. The API accepts only URLs, not direct file uploads. Not idempotent: each call queues a new transcription job.

Fetches a Fireflies user profile (name, email, admin status, transcript counts, integrations) by user ID. Use when the agent needs account details for a specific user; requires the exact user ID. Read-only and idempotent.

new_transcription_completed.name: new_transcription_completed
new_transcription_completed.description: Triggered when a new meeting is transcribed.

webhookInstructions.description:
## Fireflies.ai Webhook Setup
			To use this trigger, you need to manually set up a webhook in your Fireflies.ai account:

			1. Login to your Fireflies.ai account.
			2. Navigate to **Settings** > **Developer Settings** in the left sidebar.
			3. Enter the following URL in the webhooks field:
			```text
			{{webhookUrl}}
			```
			4. Click Save to register the webhook.

			This webhook will be triggered when a meeting transcription is completed.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when Fireflies finishes transcribing a meeting, emitting the completed transcript with its summary, speakers, attendees, and media URLs. Represents a freshly available, fully processed meeting record. Requires a manually configured Fireflies webhook.

de.\n\t\t\t## Fireflies.ai Webhook Setup\n\:
## Fireflies.ai Webhook Setup
			Um diesen Trigger zu verwenden, müssen Sie manuell einen Webhook in Ihren Fireflies einrichten. i Konto:

			1. Melden Sie sich bei Ihrem Fireflies.ai-Konto an.
			2. Navigieren Sie zu **Einstellungen** > **Entwicklereinstellungen** in der linken Seitenleiste.
			3. Geben Sie die folgende URL in das Feld Webhooks ein:
			```text
			{{webhookUrl}}
			```
			4. Klicken Sie auf Speichern, um den Webhook zu registrieren.

			Dieser Webhook wird ausgelöst, wenn eine Meeting-Transkription abgeschlossen ist.

fr.\n\t\t\t## Fireflies.ai Webhook Setup\n\:
## Configuration du Webhook Fireflies.ai
			Pour utiliser ce déclencheur, vous devez configurer manuellement un webhook dans vos Fireflies. compte i :

			1. Connectez-vous à votre compte Fireflies.ai.
			2. Allez dans **Paramètres** > **Paramètres du développeur** dans la barre latérale gauche.
			3. Entrez l'URL suivante dans le champ webhooks :
			```text
			{{webhookUrl}}
			```
			4. Cliquez sur Enregistrer pour enregistrer le webhook.

			Ce webhook sera déclenché quand la transcription d'une réunion sera terminée.

es.\n\t\t\t## Fireflies.ai Webhook Setup\n\:
## Fireflies.ai Webhook Setup
			Para utilizar este activador, necesita configurar manualmente un webhook en sus Fireflies. Cuenta i:

			1. Inicie sesión en su cuenta Fireflies.ai.
			2. Navegue a **Ajustes** > **Configuración del desarrollador** en la barra izquierda.
